pages.quiz:
FRENCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Fill in: Aujourd'hui, c'est jeudi. Hier, c'était ______. (1 mark)
   A. lundi
   B. mercredi
   C. samedi
   D. vendredi

2. Which little word goes with 'garçon' (the boy)? (1 mark)
   A. la
   B. les
   C. le
   D. l'

3. Which little word goes with 'grand-père' (the grandfather)? (1 mark)
   A. le
   B. la
   C. les
   D. l'

4. How do you say 'the family' in French? (1 mark)
   A. la sœur
   B. la famille
   C. le frère
   D. le grand-père

5. How do you say 'on' in French? (1 mark)
   A. devant
   B. entre
   C. sur
   D. sous

6. Fill in: Il ______ beau. (1 mark)
   A. y a
   B. est
   C. fait
   D. pleut

7. What does 'À midi, je mange du riz et des haricots.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. I drink a juice.
   B. At midday, I eat rice and beans.
   C. It is a cake.
   D. They are mangoes.

8. What does 'au revoir' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. Pleased to meet you
   B. goodbye
   C. hi, bye
   D. Sir, Mr

9. Which is the correct spelling of the French word for 'health'? (1 mark)
   A. santè
   B. saté
   C. sante
   D. santé

10. How do you write the number 11 in French? (1 mark)
   A. dix-sept
   B. deux
   C. onze
   D. cinq

11. What does 'entre' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. between
   B. behind
   C. in
   D. on

12. What does 'Il y a du vent.' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. It is freezing.
   B. It is hot.
   C. It is windy.
   D. The weather is nice.

13. Read: Aujourd'hui, c'est le 12 mai. C'est l'anniversaire d'Amina. Elle a dix ans. Il y a un gâteau et dix bougies. Question: What is the date? (1 mark)
   A. 12 March
   B. 12 May
   C. 10 May
   D. 2 May

14. Which little word goes with 'riz' (the rice)? (1 mark)
   A. l'
   B. les
   C. le
   D. la

15. What does 'la jambe' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the leg
   B. the eyes
   C. the stomach
   D. the hand

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Translate into French: 'On Sunday, I go to church.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

17. Translate into French: 'Where is the cat?' (3 marks) (3 marks)

18. Translate into English: 'Ce sont des mangues.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

19. Translate into French: 'It is on the table.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

20. Translate into French: 'The rug is in front of the sofa.' (3 marks) (3 marks)
pages.answers:
FRENCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — mercredi
   Yesterday was the day before Thursday, which is Wednesday.

2. C — le
   garçon is masculine, so we say le garçon.

3. A — le
   grand-père is masculine, so we say le grand-père.

4. B — la famille
   the family in French is la famille.

5. C — sur
   on in French is sur.

6. C — fait
   Il fait beau means the weather is nice.

7. B — At midday, I eat rice and beans.
   À midi, je mange du riz et des haricots. means At midday, I eat rice and beans.

8. B — goodbye
   au revoir means goodbye.

9. D — santé
   The correct spelling is santé, with its accents.

10. C — onze
   11 in French is onze.

11. A — between
   entre means between.

12. C — It is windy.
   Il y a du vent. means It is windy..

13. B — 12 May
   Le 12 mai.

14. C — le
   riz is masculine, so we say le riz.

15. A — the leg
   la jambe means the leg.

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: Le dimanche, je vais à l'église.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for correct words, articles, accents and punctuation: 3 marks in total.

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: Où est le chat ?
   Working / marking points: Award marks for correct words, articles, accents and punctuation: 3 marks in total.

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: They are mangoes.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for each correct part of the meaning: 3 marks in total.

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: Il est sur la table.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for correct words, articles, accents and punctuation: 3 marks in total.

20. (3 marks)
   Answer: Le tapis est devant le canapé.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for correct words, articles, accents and punctuation: 3 marks in total.
